assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of atrial fibrillation, raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia recurrence.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Diagnosis codes Z86.73, I48.91, and R00.2 are associated with the patient.
Continuous monitoring via CPT 93229 is indicated.
The clinical indication note states that continuous monitoring is indicated to detect potential embolic sources or rhythm disturbances that may have been missed on standard ECG.
The claim for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on reason code CO-197.
The required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date.
SilverBridge Advantage requires prior approval for this specific diagnostic procedure.
The patient has the right to appeal this determination.
Detailed instructions regarding the appeals process, including necessary documentation and submission deadlines, are available in the member handbook or by contacting Member Services.
